prompts.crew: Use case: style-transfer / recomposition. Create a full-bleed landscape background asset for a mobile travel app action card, wide horizontal composition about 2:1. Image 1 is the landscape edit target: extend and recompose it into a panorama while retaining its hand-painted watercolor medium, visible fine watercolor paper grain, softly layered pigments, sage and pine greens, pale blue mountains, warm cream sunlight, detailed but painterly foliage. Image 2 is a supporting illustration/style reference. This is ONLY the background artwork, not an app screenshot or UI mockup. No typography, lettering, logos, symbols, buttons, badges, frames, borders or watermarks. No photographic realism, 3D rendering, plastic or vector-art aesthetic. Paint the landscape edge to edge with no transparency. Compose the meaningful subjects within the rightmost 30% of the image and within the middle 65% vertically, so they survive a mobile cover crop. The left 60% must remain a calm uninterrupted landscape with broad soft washes, distant terrain and low detail, suitable for a text overlay later; do not bake the overlay into the art. Primary change: on the right, three adult travelers seen mostly from behind on a small mountain meadow trail, with relaxed friendly body language and daypacks, enjoying the view together. Natural proportions and understated faces; keep the group fully within the frame, slightly below the horizon, not filling the whole image. Lush pine valley, rolling green slopes and soft blue ridges in the distance. Cooler teal and sage atmosphere, fresh summer daylight. No campervans, vehicles, tents, campfire or maps. On the left show only softly layered forested hills and a quiet meadow, without foreground clutter. Keep the painting coherent, not a detached cutout collage.
